goal: Selection clear/undo, catalog batch actions and history reference tracing.

implementation.undo: Single in-memory snapshot; newer edits invalidate it. Person, prompt, settings and completed results survive reference clearing. Reload does not restore undo.
implementation.batch: Select displayed atomic material variants; prune filtered or changed variants; idempotent favorite updates; basket union validation is atomic.
implementation.history: Stored input blobs first, exact trusted catalog links, explicitly labeled current catalog fallback and missing original inputs. Viewer owns only its own reference object URLs.

browser.accessibility: No serious or critical WCAG2A/AA violations in new catalog batch UI and active history modal. Native modal scope excludes inert background.

privacy: Only synthetic fixture images and existing local catalog assets used. No private photos read or copied; no paid generation calls.
deployment: Local implementation only; not committed or pushed.
